checkpoint: The BIKE VOUCHER and the BICYCLE, from Vermilion's Center to Cerulean's (pokeguy 43:50 to 45:00).

The Pokemon Fan Club (VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub map.json, scripts.inc), in by Vermilion's (12, 17): the chairman (5, 4) sits above a table (5..6, 5..6) with the worker (6, 4) east of him, so he is talked to from (4, 4), west of him. "Did you come to hear about my POKEMON?" YES: his story, then the BIKE VOUCHER (FLAG_GOT_BIKE_VOUCHER). Oak's aide stands on Vermilion's (25, 7) since Lt. Surge, where the story's maps don't have him: the way planned from the Center's door goes east along his row 7, so the walk goes down to the water (14, 10) first, as 06.04 came up from it. From the Fan Club, up to (22, 10) first, so that the way on to Route 6 goes up column 22, west of him, not round by column 27.

Route 6 north, the trainers as 05.10 left them: Jeff (13, 33) beaten, Isabelle (13, 32) and Elijah (20, 25) not. As in 06.03, onto Jeff's row, west to the wall (7, 33) and up to row 31, above Isabelle's line; then east along row 31 to the wall (17, 31) and up column 16, west of Elijah's line (17..19, 25) and east of Keigo's (4..8, 16), to the ledge (16, 11). The first three legs are 06.03's, walked on console B; the two after end on walls, which the walker holds again after a wild battle in the grass.
The Underground Path north, Route 5's sides, which have no trainer, and Cerulean's south edge, whose way into the city without the burgled house is the tree (26, 32) (pokeguy 44:42).

The Bike Shop (CeruleanCity_BikeShop), in by (13, 28): the clerk (9, 3) is across the counter (8, 3), talked to from (7, 3). With the voucher he gives the BICYCLE (FLAG_GOT_BICYCLE) with no YES/NO; it isn't registered or ridden yet.

The Mart: 5 Repels (row 9, 350 each) and 2 Escape Ropes (row 8, 550 each; pokefirered items.json), 2850 in all. Console B had about 9000 after Lt. Surge (2026-11-03); the floor of 6000 leaves 3000 or more after them.
The nurse, and the save in Cerulean's Center.
